name: overlay
description: Overlay services (BRC-22 submit, BRC-24 lookup; docs/OVERLAY.md): the engine handles the submit entries, the chain feed and the status provider's messages, and serves submit and lookup as route handlers; tm_demo and ls_demo are its example topic manager and lookup service. Its configuration is config.overlay, read from the app record at every step; the install derives its wiring from it (boxes submit, chain, status; routes /submit, /lookup, libp2p:<topic>, -admit, -proof; heads ls:<service>). Gossip on <topic>, <topic>-admit, <topic>-proof (#74).
